title: Biznes yozishmalar
goal_uz: Dars oxirida ingliz tilida ishonchli biznes xatlari yozasiz: taklifnomaning tuzilishi, rasmiy shikoyat va uzr, ishonchli register, qisqa va aniq javoblar.

vocab.w: i hope this email finds you well

scenes.title: Biznes yozishmalar
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda professional muzokaralarni o‘rgandik. Bugun ingliz tilida biznes yozishmalarni o‘rganamiz: taklifnoma va shikoyat xatlarining tuzilishi, rasmiy shikoyat va uzr, ishonchli register, qisqa javoblar. Dars oxirida taklifnoma va shikoyatga javob yozasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome to lesson two of PRO 2! Today we learn how to write proposals, complaints and replies in English.
scenes.say_uz: PRO 2 ning ikkinchi darsiga xush kelibsiz! Bugun ingliz tilida taklifnoma, shikoyat va javoblar yozishni o‘rganamiz.

scenes.title: Biznes xat tuzilishi: subject, greeting, body, sign-off

examples.t: Subject: Proposal for Q3 Marketing Campaign
examples.uz: Mavzu: Q3 marketing kampaniya uchun taklifnoma.

scenes.say_native: Ingliz tilidagi biznes xatining beshta qismi. Birinchisi — „Subject: Proposal for Q3 Marketing Campaign“ — mavzu: Q3 marketing kampaniya uchun taklifnoma — xatning nomi — aniq va qisqa. Ikkinchisi — „Dear Mr. Smith,“ — hurmatli janob Smit, — ism + familya — „Dear“ majburiy. Uchinchisi — „I am writing to…“ — men … sabab yozyapman — maqsadingizni ayting. To‘rtinchisi — asosiy qism — qisqa, aniq, dalillar bilan. Beshinchisi — „Regards“ yoki „Sincerely“ — imzo. Eng ko‘p uchraydigan xato: mavzusiz xat — „Subject yo‘q — xat o‘qilmaydi“ — mavzu majburiy — xatingiz 2 soniyada tushunilishi kerak. Eslab qoling: mavzu — salom — maqsad — asosiy qism — imzo.
scenes.say: Subject: Proposal for Q3 Marketing Campaign. Dear Mr. Smith, I am writing to propose a three-month campaign to increase sign-ups. Kindly review the attached plan. I look forward to your feedback. Regards.
scenes.say_uz: Mavzu: Q3 marketing kampaniya uchun taklifnoma. Hurmatli janob Smit, men imzolashni ko‘paytirish uchun uch oylik kampaniya taklif qilish uchun yozyapman. Iltimos, biriktirilgan rejani ko‘rib chiqing. Fikr-mulohazangizni kutyapman. Hurmat bilan.

scenes.title: Biznes xat tuzilishi mashqi
scenes.say_native: Uchta qismni yozing. Birinchi: mavzu — „Subject: Proposal for Q3 Marketing Campaign“. Ikkinchi: salom — „Dear Mr. Smith,“. Uchinchi: imzo — „Regards“. Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida ayting.
scenes.say: Write a subject line. Write a greeting. Write a sign-off. Three parts — say them aloud in English.
scenes.say_uz: Mavzu qatorini yozing. Salomni yozing. Imzoni yozing. Bu uchta qismni ingliz tilida baland ovozda ayting.

scenes.title: Rasmiy email: Dear …, I hope this email finds you well
board: I hope this email finds you well

examples.t: Dear Ms. Karimova, I hope this email finds you well.
examples.uz: Hurmatli xonim Karimova, umidam siz yaxshisiz.

examples.t: I am writing to follow up on our meeting last week.
examples.uz: Men o‘tgan haftadagi yig‘ilishimiz bo‘yicha yozyapman.

scenes.say_native: Rasmiy ingliz emailining uchta asosiy qoidasi. Birinchisi — „Dear Ms. Karimova, I hope this email finds you well“ — hurmatli xonim Karimova, umidam siz yaxshisiz — standart salom — bu iborani har doim ishlating — ingliz tilida bu juda keng tarqalgan. Ikkinchisi — „I am writing to follow up on our meeting last week“ — men o‘tgan haftadagi yig‘ilishimiz bo‘yicha yozyapman — nima sabab yozyapsiz — maqsadni aniq ayting — noaniq maqsad — xat o‘qilmaydi. Uchinchisi — „I look forward to your reply“ — javobingizni kutyapman — xatni yakunlash — „kindly“ — iltimos — muloyim so‘rov — „Kindly review the file“ — iltimos, faylni ko‘rib chiqing. Eng ko‘p uchraydigan xato: norasmiy salom rasmiy odamga — „Hey!“ — „Dear …“ emas, bu hurmatsizlik — rasmiy munosabatlar buziladi. Eslab qoling: „Dear“ + familya + „I hope this email finds you well“ + „I am writing to“ — rasmiy ochilish.
scenes.say: Dear Ms. Karimova, I hope this email finds you well. I am writing to follow up on our meeting last week. Please find attached the revised proposal. I look forward to your reply.
scenes.say_uz: Hurmatli xonim Karimova, umidam siz yaxshisiz. Men o‘tgan haftadagi yig‘ilishimiz bo‘yicha yozyapman. Biriktirilgan qayta ishlangan taklifnomani ko‘ring. Javobingizni kutyapman.

scenes.title: Rasmiy email mashqi
scenes.say_native: Uchta rasmiy ochilish gapi tuzing. Birinchi: „Dear Ms. Karimova,“ — salom — familya bilan. Ikkinchi: „I hope this email finds you well“ — umidam yaxshisiz — har xatda ishlatiladi. Uchinchi: „I look forward to your reply“ — javobingizni kutyapman — xatni chiroyli yakunlash. Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida ayting — ohang muloyim va professional bo‘lsin — har bir gap aniq va qisqa.
scenes.say: Dear Ms. Karimova, I hope this email finds you well. I look forward to your reply. Write your own formal opening lines in English.
scenes.say_uz: Hurmatli xonim Karimova, umidam siz yaxshisiz. Javobingizni kutyapman. O‘zingizning rasmiy ochilish gaplaringizni ingliz tilida ayting.

scenes.title: Taklifnomaning tuzilishi: muammo, yechim, xarajat, vaqt
board: Cost and timeline — xarajat va vaqt

examples.t: Problem: sign-ups dropped by 15 % last quarter.
examples.uz: Muammo: o‘tgan chorakda imzolashlar 15 foizga tushdi.
Taklif qilinayotgan yechim: uch oylik kampaniya.

scenes.say_native: Taklifnomaning to‘rtta asosiy qismi. Birinchisi — „Problem: sign-ups dropped by 15 % last quarter“ — muammo: o‘tgan chorakda imzolashlar 15 foizga tushdi — muammoni aniq raqam bilan ko‘rsating — raqamsiz muammo ishonchli emas. Ikkinchisi — „Proposed solution: a three-month campaign“ — taklif qilinayotgan yechim: uch oylik kampaniya — yechimni nomi bilan ayting — qisqa va aniq — „I propose to…“ — men taklif qilaman. Uchinchisi — „Cost and timeline“ — xarajat va vaqt — „The budget is 5 million, delivery by end of June“ — byudjet 5 million, iyun oxirigacha yetkazib beramiz — xarajat va vaqt — har doim raqam bilan. To‘rtinchisi — „Benefit“ — foyda — „Expected result: 25 % increase in sign-ups“ — kutilayotgan natija: imzolashlar 25 foizga oshadi — mijoz nima yutadi. Eslab qoling: muammo — yechim — xarajat — foyda — taklifnomaning to‘rt ustuni.
scenes.say: Problem: sign-ups dropped by 15 % last quarter. Proposed solution: a three-month campaign. The budget is 5 million, delivery by end of June. Expected result: a 25 % increase in sign-ups.
scenes.say_uz: Muammo: o‘tgan chorakda imzolashlar 15 foizga tushdi. Taklif: uch oylik kampaniya. Byudjet 5 million, iyun oxirigacha yetkazib beramiz. Kutilayotgan natija: imzolashlar 25 foizga oshishi.

scenes.title: Taklifnoma mashqi
scenes.say_native: Uchta taklifnoma qismi yozing. Birinchi: „Problem: …“ — muammo raqam bilan. Ikkinchi: „Proposed solution: …“ — yechim. Uchinchi: „Expected result: …“ — kutilayotgan natija. Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida ayting.
scenes.say: Problem — state the issue with a number. Solution — propose the fix. Expected result — state the outcome. Say all three in English.
scenes.say_uz: Muammo — muammoni raqam bilan ayting. Yechim — taklifni ayting. Kutilayotgan natija — natijani ayting. Bu uchtasini ham ingliz tilida ayting.

scenes.title: Rasmiy shikoyat va uzr: complaint and apology
board: I am writing to express my concern

examples.t: I am writing to express my concern about the delayed order.
examples.uz: Men kechikkan buyurtma haqida tashvishimni bildirish uchun yozyapman.

examples.t: We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.

scenes.say_native: Shikoyat va uzrning uchta qoidasi. Birinchisi — shikoyat — „I am writing to express my concern about the delayed order“ — men kechikkan buyurtma haqida tashvishimni bildirish uchun yozyapman — muammoni aniq ayting. Ikkinchisi — uzr — „We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience“ — noqulayliklar uchun samimiy uzr so‘raymiz — „sincerely apologize“ — rasmiy uzr. Uchinchisi — tuzatish — „We will make it right“ — biz buni tuzatamiz — nima qilasiz — aniq harakat — „We are resending the order today with priority shipping“ — bugun buyurtmani tez yetkazib berish bilan qayta yuboramiz. Eslab qoling: tashvish bildiring — uzr so‘rang — tuzatish taklif qiling — shikoyatning uch qadami.
scenes.say: I am writing to express my concern about the delayed order. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience. We are resending the order today with priority shipping. Thank you for your patience.
scenes.say_uz: Men kechikkan buyurtma haqida tashvishimni bildirish uchun yozyapman. Noqulayliklar uchun samimiy uzr so‘raymiz. Biz buyurtmani bugun tez yetkazib berish bilan qayta yuboramiz. Sabr-toqatingiz uchun rahmat.

scenes.title: Shikoyat va uzr mashqi
scenes.say_native: Uchta gap tuzing. Birinchi: „I am writing to express my concern about…“ — tashvish bildiring. Ikkinchi: „We sincerely apologize“ — samimiy uzr. Uchinchi: „We will make it right“ — biz tuzatamiz — nima qilishingizni ayting. Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida ayting.
scenes.say: I am writing to express my concern about the delay. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience. We will make it right — we are resending it today.
scenes.say_uz: Men kechikish haqida tashvishimni bildirish uchun yozyapman. Noqulayliklar uchun samimiy uzr so‘raymiz. Biz buni tuzatamiz — biz uni bugun qayta yuboramiz.

scenes.title: ESCUCHA 1: shikoyat xati bo‘yicha suhbat
board: A: I am writing to express my concern about the delayed order.
B: I see. What is the order number?
B: We will make it right.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi suhbatni tinglang — shikoyat xati bo‘yicha suhbat. A: „I am writing to express my concern about the delayed order“ — men kechikkan buyurtma haqida tashvishimni bildirish uchun yozyapman. B: „I see. What is the order number?“ — tushundim. Buyurtma raqami nima? A: „It is A-1234“ — A-1234. B: „We will make it right“ — biz buni tuzatamiz. Diqqat qiling: shikoyat — aniq buyurtma raqami — tuzatish — shikoyatning oqimi.
scenes.say: I am writing to express my concern about the delayed order. I see. What is the order number? It is A-1234. We will make it right.
scenes.say_uz: Men kechikkan buyurtma haqida tashvishimni bildirish uchun yozyapman. Tushundim. Buyurtma raqami nima? U A-1234. Biz buni tuzatamiz.

scenes.title: Suhbat 1 bo‘yicha savollar
scenes.say_native: Suhbat bo‘yicha to‘rtta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: A nima yozadi — kechikkan buyurtma haqida tashvish. Ikkinchi: buyurtma raqami nima — A-1234. Uchinchi: B qanday tuzatish taklif qiladi — biz buni tuzatamiz. To‘rtinchi: ohang qanday — muloyim va professional. Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida ayting.
scenes.say: What is A concerned about? What is the order number? How will B make it right? What is the tone? Answer in English.
scenes.say_uz: A nimadan tashvishda? Buyurtma raqami nima? B qanday tuzatadi? Ohang qanday? Ingliz tilida javob bering.

scenes.title: Javoblar: suhbat 1
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. A: „I am writing to express my concern about the delayed order“ — kechikkan buyurtma haqida tashvish. Buyurtma raqami — „A-1234“. B: „We will make it right“ — biz buni tuzatamiz — tuzatish va‘dasi. Ingliz tilida shikoyat qiling — tashvish bildiring, uzr so‘rang, tuzatish taklif qiling. Muntazam mashq qiling.
scenes.say: A is concerned about a delayed order. The order number is A-1234. B will make it right — they promise to fix it. Expressing concern, apologising and fixing — the three steps of a complaint.
scenes.say_uz: A kechikkan buyurtma haqida tashvishda. Buyurtma raqami A-1234. B buni tuzatishga va’da beradi. Tashvish bildiring, uzr so‘rang, tuzating — shikoyatning uch qadami.

scenes.title: Ishonchli register: persuasive writing

examples.t: This will save you 20 % on logistics.
Act now — the offer expires on 30 June.
examples.uz: Hozir harakat qiling — taklif 30 iyunda tugaydi.

scenes.say_native: Ishonchli registerning uchta qoidasi. Birinchisi — foydani avval ayting — „This will save you 20 % on logistics“ — bu sizga logistikada 20 foiz tejaydi — mijoz nima yutadi. Ikkinchisi — raqamlar bilan — „Act now — the offer expires on 30 June“ — hozir harakat qiling — taklif 30 iyunda tugaydi — aniq raqam ishontiradi. Uchinchisi — aktiv qo‘llanish — „We will deliver by Friday“ — biz juma kuni yetkazib beramiz — aktiv — sust qo‘llanish emas. Eslab qoling: foyda — raqam — aktiv — ishonchli register.
scenes.say: This will save you 20 % on logistics. Act now — the offer expires on 30 June. We will deliver by Friday. Benefit first, numbers, active voice — three rules of persuasion.
scenes.say_uz: Bu sizga logistikada 20 foiz tejaydi. Hozir harakat qiling — taklif 30 iyunda tugaydi. Biz juma kuni yetkazib beramiz. Foyda avval, raqamlar, aktiv qo‘llanish — ishontirishning uchta qoidasi.

scenes.title: Ishonchli register mashqi
scenes.say_native: Uchta ishonchli gap yozing. Birinchi: „This will save you…“ — foyda. Ikkinchi: „Act now — the offer expires…“ — raqam. Uchinchi: „We will deliver by Friday“ — aktiv. Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida ayting.
scenes.say: This will save you money. Act now — the offer expires soon. We will deliver by Friday. Write three persuasive sentences in English.
scenes.say_uz: Bu sizga pul tejaydi. Hozir harakat qiling — taklif tez orada tugaydi. Biz juma kuni yetkazib beramiz. Bu uchta ishontiruvchi gapni ingliz tilida ayting.

scenes.title: ESCUCHA 2: javob xati
board: A: I am writing to express my concern about your service.
A: We will make it right.
B: Thank you for your patience.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi suhbatni tinglang — javob xati. A: „I am writing to express my concern about your service“ — men sizning xizmatingiz haqida tashvishimni bildirish uchun yozyapman. B: „We sincerely apologize“ — samimiy uzr. A: „We will make it right“ — biz buni tuzatamiz. B: „Thank you for your patience“ — sabr-toqatingiz uchun rahmat. Diqqat qiling: tashvish — uzr — tuzatish — rahmat — to‘liq oqim. Savollar: A nimadan tashvishda va B qanday javob beradi?
scenes.say: I am writing to express my concern about your service. We sincerely apologize. We will make it right. Thank you for your patience.
scenes.say_uz: Men sizning xizmatingiz haqida tashvishimni bildirish uchun yozyapman. Samimiy uzr so‘raymiz. Biz buni tuzatamiz. Sabr-toqatingiz uchun rahmat.

scenes.title: Suhbat 2 bo‘yicha savollar
scenes.say_native: Suhbat bo‘yicha to‘rtta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: A nimadan tashvishda — xizmat haqida. Ikkinchi: B nima deydi — samimiy uzr. Uchinchi: A nima qiladi — biz buni tuzatamiz. To‘rtinchi: ohang qanday — muloyim. Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida ayting.
scenes.say: What is A concerned about? What does B say? What will A do? What is the tone? Answer in English.
scenes.say_uz: A nimadan tashvishda? B nima deydi? A nima qiladi? Ohang qanday? Ingliz tilida javob bering.

scenes.title: Javoblar: suhbat 2
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. A ning shikoyati — „I am writing to express my concern about your service“ — xizmat sifati. B ning javobi — „We sincerely apologize“ — samimiy uzr. A ning tuzatishi — „We will make it right“ — biz buni tuzatamiz. Ingliz tilida shikoyat va javob — har doim muloyim va tuzatish bilan. Muntazam mashq qiling.
scenes.say: A is concerned about the service. B sincerely apologizes. A will make it right. In English, complaints and replies are always polite and solution-oriented.
scenes.say_uz: A xizmatdan tashvishda. B samimiy uzr so‘raydi. A buni tuzatadi. Ingliz tilida shikoyat va javob har doim muloyim va yechimga yo‘naltirilgan.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: taklifnoma yozing
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy topshiriq. Ingliz tilida taklifnoma yozing: 1) mavzu — aniq; 2) salom — Dear; 3) muammo — raqam bilan; 4) yechim — taklif; 5) xarajat va vaqt; 6) kutilayotgan natija. Javoblaringizni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Write a full English proposal: subject, greeting, problem with numbers, solution, cost and timeline, expected result.
scenes.say_uz: Ingliz tilida to‘liq taklifnoma yozing: mavzu, salom, muammo raqam bilan, yechim, xarajat va vaqt, kutilayotgan natija.

scenes.title: Namuna taklifnoma
scenes.say_native: Namuna taklifnoma. „Subject: Proposal for a Q3 marketing campaign. Dear Ms. Karimova, I hope this email finds you well. Sign-ups dropped by 15 % last quarter. I propose a three-month campaign to increase sign-ups. The budget is 5 million and delivery is by end of June. Expected result: a 25 % increase. I look forward to your feedback. Regards, Bekzod.“ Sizning taklifnomangiz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin — muhimi professional va ishonchli. Ingliz tilida har bir xat — aniq maqsad bilan.
scenes.say: Subject: Proposal for a Q3 marketing campaign. Dear Ms. Karimova, I hope this email finds you well. Sign-ups dropped by 15 % last quarter. I propose a three-month campaign. The budget is 5 million, delivery by end of June. Expected result: a 25 % increase. I look forward to your feedback. Regards, Bekzod.
scenes.say_uz: Mavzu: Q3 marketing kampaniya uchun taklifnoma. Hurmatli xonim Karimova, umidam siz yaxshisiz. O‘tgan chorakda imzolashlar 15 foizga tushdi. Men imzolashlarni oshirish uchun uch oylik kampaniya taklif qilaman. Byudjet 5 million, iyun oxirigacha yetkazib beramiz. Kutilayotgan natija: 25 foiz oshish. Fikr-mulohazangizni kutyapman. Hurmat bilan, Bekzod.

scenes.title: Bugun nimani o‘rgandik
scenes.say_native: Bugun nimani o‘rgandik? Ingliz tilida biznes yozishmalarni: xat tuzilishini — mavzu, salom, maqsad, asosiy qism, imzo; rasmiy emailni; taklifnoma tuzilishini — muammo, yechim, xarajat, foyda; shikoyat va uzrni; ishonchli registerni. Endi har qanday biznes xatini professional yozasiz.
scenes.say: Today we learned business writing in English: letter structure, formal emails, proposals, complaints and replies. Keep practicing.
scenes.say_uz: Bugun ingliz tilida biznes yozishmalarni o‘rgandik: xat tuzilishi, rasmiy email, taklifnoma, shikoyat va javoblar. Mashq qilishni davom ettiring.

scenes.title: Uyga vazifa
board: Keyingi dars: Hisobot va tahliliy matn
scenes.say_native: Uyga vazifa. Ingliz tilida taklifnoma va shikoyatga javob yozing — mavzu, salom, muammo, yechim, tuzatish va foyda bilan. Keyingi darsda hisobot va tahliliy matnni o‘rganamiz. Goodbye!
scenes.say: Write an English proposal and a reply to a complaint. Next lesson: reports and analytical text. Goodbye!
scenes.say_uz: Ingliz tilida taklifnoma va shikoyatga javob yozing. Keyingi darsda hisobot va tahliliy matnni o‘rganamiz. Xayr!

homework_uz: Ingliz tilida to‘liq taklifnoma yozing — mavzu, muammo raqam bilan, yechim, xarajat va vaqt, kutilayotgan natija — va shikoyatga rasmiy javob yozing. Keyingi dars: Hisobot va tahliliy matn.

quiz.why_uz: Mavzu, salom, maqsad, asosiy qism, imzo.

quiz.q: „I hope this email finds you well“ nimani bildiradi?
„I look forward to your reply“ nimani bildiradi?
